Reported with an amendment, committed to the Committee of the Whole House on the State of the Union, and ordered to be printed

For text of introduced bill, see copy of bill as introduced on January 22, 2025

form.official-title: To clarify where court may be held for certain district courts in Texas and California.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Local Access to Courts Act of 2026 or LACA of 2026.
Section 124(b)(2) of title 28, United States Code, is amended, in the matter preceding paragraph (3), by inserting and College Station before the period at the end.
Section 84(d) of title 28, United States Code, is amended by inserting and El Centro after at San Diego.
